name: Streaming Algorithmic Trading Regulation And Stock Market Liquidity Evidence From China S  226831Bd25
text: Algorithmic Trading Regulation and Stock Market Liquidity reports that China's 2024 program-trading rules narrowed bid-ask spreads and reduced price impact in the A-share market. This adds a regulation-mediated spread mechanism to Kaal's observation that liquidity injection narrows spreads in traditional markets. The result is confined to China's A-share market and does not establish the same effect in crypto markets or from dual listing.
